# BREP-10 defect corpus

Small text `.brep` shapes, each a valid part (box, cylinder or square face) with one defect made
by construction, for the healing and `check` tests of `amg-brep` (`tests/heal.rs`). They are
generated by this repository (`cargo run -p amg-brep --features fixture-gen --example
gen_brep_defects`; builders `defect_*` in `crates/amg-occt-sys/cpp/occt_fixtures.cpp`) and are
under the project's licence. Plain git files, not LFS.
